source_text: Hodie abstuli opprobrium Aegypti a vobis — circumcisio secunda in colle praeputiorum. Qui inoboedientes incircumcisi dicuntur; circumcidenda non solum idololatria sed vitia subtiliora. Exaltavit Dominus Iesum in conspectu Israel cum Iordanen transiit et populum circumcidit. Manna cessat; fructus terrae eduntur. Nos post baptismum secunda circumcisione cordis Aegypti opprobriis liberati, Iesu duce terram repromissionis intramus. Cui gloria in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Today I-removed reproach of-Egypt from you — circumcision second on hill of-foreskins. Who disobedient uncircumcised are-said; to-be-circumcised not only idolatry but vices subtler. Exalted Lord Jesus in sight of-Israel when Jordan he-crossed and people he-circumcised. Manna ceases; fruits of-land are-eaten. We after baptism by-second circumcision of-heart from-of-Egypt reproaches freed, with-Jesus leader land of-promise we-enter. To-whom glory into ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you >> Bible:Joshua 5:9]] — the second circumcision at the hill of foreskins. The disobedient are called uncircumcised; what must be circumcised is not only idolatry but subtler vices. The Lord [[exalted Jesus in Israel’s sight >> Bible:Joshua 3:7; 4:14]] when he crossed the Jordan and circumcised the people. [[Manna ceased >> Bible:Joshua 5:12]]; the land’s fruits are eaten. We who after baptism are freed from Egypt’s reproaches by the heart’s second circumcision enter the land of promise with Jesus as guide. To him be glory forever. Amen.
